Finishes Are The Point

Anyone can put paint on a wall. What separates a finished room is the surface under it — flat, smooth, matched and clean at every edge. That is the work FJ Authentic Finish is hired for.

01

Smooth & Level 5

Walls and ceilings skimmed and sanded to a glass-flat finish that holds up in Florida sunlight — no seams, no ridges, no flashing.

02

Texture Matching

Knockdown, orange-peel and custom textures matched to your existing walls, so repairs and additions disappear completely.

03

Factory-Smooth Cabinets

Cabinets prepped and sprayed for a factory finish — the fastest way to make a kitchen look brand new.

04

Clean Final Coat

Sharp lines, protected floors and a final walk-through eye on every corner. The finish is checked the way you will look at it: up close.

Common Questions

How does the estimate work?

Estimates are free. Call (813) 361-5742, email Jardellangell02@gmail.com or send us a DM on Instagram with a few photos of your project and we will set up your estimate.

Do you repair drywall, or only install?

Both — drywall installation and repair, finished smooth and ready for texture and paint.

Can you match my existing texture?

Yes — custom textures and finishes are our specialty, including matching knockdown and orange-peel.

Do you paint cabinets and stain decks?

Yes — cabinet painting and refinishing, and deck stain and protection, are part of our services.
